context: Third real measurement (row 1360): A dropped 55.5s -> 38.7s with 2 parallel slices and B's cost halved thanks to the short prompt, but B+C stayed at 93.3s although the maths says ~30s. Diagnosis: the parallel calls do NOT run truly in parallel — the API key's throughput is shared, so every parallelization returns only ~30% instead of 50%. Conclusion agreed with the user: further splitting is pointless; the remaining levers are FEWER TOKENS and PERCEIVED time. The user chose to implement perceived time (Idea 4) first, in-app screen only.
feature: Live progress on the upload screen + preliminary results table shown as soon as the extraction stage finishes
design: Services/InterpretationProgressTracker.cs — in-memory, short TTL (20 min), keyed by a client-generated GUID. Throw-away UI state; never a source of truth.
GeminiMedicalInterpretationService.OnStage hook — the split pipeline calls it with the analytes the instant stage A finishes; the controller forwards that to the tracker.
GET /Interpretation/Progress?token=... returns JSON {stage, table, outOfRange, analytes, error}; requires a logged-in session.

The POST flow is UNCHANGED (same synchronous request, same redirect): the browser simply polls every 1.5s and paints what the server reports, so there is no new failure mode and no background-job infrastructure.

Upload.cshtml — 5 live steps with animated dots, an elapsed-seconds counter, and a scrollable preliminary table (name / value+unit with arrow / reference range) with out-of-range rows highlighted; 9 new Loc keys x 7 languages (63 keys).
Monolithic mode still gets the step progress (no early table, since there is no separate extraction stage).
effect: The user sees the full table of values, with the out-of-range ones highlighted, at ~40s instead of staring at a spinner for ~157s.
test_type: END-TO-END probe against a local fake Gemini + tracker unit checks + a rendered HTML/CSS preview screenshot of the overlay
new_checks: Progress hook fires exactly once, with all 40 extracted analytes, and fires BEFORE the pipeline completes (measured: at +351ms of a 776ms run)

Tracker: stage stored; table published with blank names skipped and statuses normalized; out-of-range counted; stage advances to the explanation step; failures recorded; unknown/null token is a safe no-op
All previous checks still pass (chunked extraction, sweep, short stage-B prompt, thinking budgets, monolithic mode untouched, monolithic fallback, out-of-range completer)
visual_check: Overlay rendered and screenshotted: steps (done/active/pending), elapsed counter, 'Primele rezultate' badge with '84 analize, 12 în afara intervalului', highlighted out-of-range rows, explanatory note. Layout clean at 1920x800.
